shortDescription: Member check-in result view entry point.
fullDescription: Renders the member check-in result screen on the home route and passes the current view state into the shared member check-in result component. Supports the planned check-in-success, payment-method-invalid, and membership-cancelled states through the shared component contract, with the route currently configured to show the payment-method-invalid state.

shortDescription: Reusable gym member check-in result screen component.
fullDescription: Displays the gym member check-in result experience with a top bar, member number search control, state-driven hero banner, member details panel, amenities grid, and bottom status banner. Accepts serializable props for state, member data, defaultMemberNumber, and onSearch so the same component can render check-in-success, payment-method-invalid, and membership-cancelled variants while keeping the search input and action immediately usable and initializing each state with matching fixture member data.
